name: Unleash
solves: Provides an open-source feature management platform with official SDKs (including `unleash-client` for Node) for gradual rollouts, strategies, constraints, and self-hosted or Unleash-hosted control planes.
best_for: Organizations that want self-hosted feature flags with a mature admin UI and multi-language SDKs
Node backends using unleash-client for server-side evaluation with streaming/polling updates
Enterprises needing flexible activation strategies and constraints without pure SaaS lock-in
Platform teams standardizing feature management across many services/languages
Migrations off homemade toggle tables toward a dedicated FM system
skip_when: You want flags bundled with product analytics (PostHog) rather than a dedicated FM tool
AGPL self-host licensing is incompatible with your distribution model — evaluate Unleash hosted or another vendor
You only need OpenFeature plumbing and will choose a different provider behind it
A tiny boolean config in env vars is enough

hosted_alternative.name: Unleash Hosted
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Open-source self-host (AGPL) available; Unleash Cloud/Enterprise plans are commercial
